decision: Make the phenotype-signal compression question the FIRST experiment; all Stage-1/Stage-2/A1-R/phenotype-gating work waits on its result
Classify this package as DESIGN_ONLY_RUN_NOT_AUTHORIZED; it authorizes no execution and no Transformer or GPU work
Fix the compression objective as unsupervised reconstruction; the correct linear null is therefore block PCA and NOT a supervised block-PLS
Pre-register the Stage-1/2 kill: A_test must beat block PCA at matched k in both within-block and between-block regimes with CV uncertainty excluding zero
Reinstate the same-dim random bilinear ablation and its geometry-specificity kill; PCA and random-bilinear answer two different questions
Reinstate the shared data contract; every arm sees byte-identical SNP set block version split folds and simulated traits
Measure compression fidelity by downstream R2/AUC on simulated traits never by reconstruction loss
Evaluate phenotype signal on simulated traits with known architecture because the panel has no real phenotypes; report within-block and between-block causal retention separately
Do not touch phenotype gating until D45 and D46 have a result
Treat the centering-defect fix binding the panel and block-version hashes and freezing the margin rule as pre-run gates before any run authorization
Use a seed namespace disjoint from v6.1 and from any v7 GPU/A1-R seed block
